evidence: STATIC: tests/Dockerfile is byte-identical to the frozen template (diff empty; also .dockerignore, test.sh, restart_mcp.py, score.py, environment/Dockerfile). It pins every grading component: node runtime copied from node:22-bookworm-slim (line 1,4), @anthropic-ai/claude-code@2.1.281, @openai/codex@0.151.0, @playwright/mcp@0.0.79, express@5.1.0, better-sqlite3@12.4.1 (lines 16-22), harbor-rewardkit==0.1.7 (line 31), Chromium installed through the MCP-bundled Playwright CLI with --with-deps and symlinked to /usr/local/bin/chromium (lines 33-39), python3 from python:3.12-slim for restart_mcp.py/score.py (stdlib-only imports: json, subprocess, sys, pathlib, math, tomllib), procps/util-linux for kill/setsid/setpriv used by test.sh (line 13), COPY . /tests (line 43). The app's only third-party requires (server.js:10-11 express, better-sqlite3) equal the agent image's global installs (environment/Dockerfile:9-12) and package.json deps at the same versions; integration.md:3 tells the builder those are the installed modules and Node 22 is used. MEASURED (9 Oct 2026, this reviewer, Docker authorised; unique tag qc-r2-row22-kittle-verifier:tmp built from the frozen task/tests context, no shared container touched): versions node v22.23.2, Python 3.12.14, Claude Code 2.1.281, codex-cli 0.151.0, rewardkit 0.1.7 (agents.py bypass patch present: grep count 1), playwright 1.63.0-alpha (chromium-1237 + headless shell), playwright-mcp 0.0.79 on PATH, base OS Debian 13 trixie. Frozen solve.sh installed the golden into /app; launched exactly like test.sh:104-111 (setsid env -i, PATH/NODE_PATH/HOME/PORT=3000/DB_PATH=/app/app.db, setpriv uid 65534, cwd /tmp): GET /api/health -> 200 {"ok":true,"booted":true,...}; Playwright Chromium via executablePath /usr/local/bin/chromium --no-sandbox headless (the judge.toml args) loaded http://localhost:3000, title 'Kittle & Rowe · Matter chat', sign-in form rendered; kill of the process group and relaunch on the same DB -> 200 again with app.db/-wal persisted; restart_mcp.py answered MCP initialize and tools/list (restart_app) under /usr/local/bin/python3 as wired in scored/functional/judge.toml:26-27. Independent of the 8 Oct scripted golden, which ran the app in the agent image (run_golden.sh:11,17) and only used a Colderwater verifier image (cw-editor-verifier:current) for the browser, so it did not by itself prove launch inside this task's verifier image. COUNTEREXAMPLE SEARCH: broken app passing this row is not applicable (the row is about image contents; a broken app still gets graded). Conforming alternative that could fail: an app vendoring its own node_modules (copied with /app, test.sh:92) or a native module built in the agent image (same Node 22 ABI, newer glibc in trixie) still loads; an app shelling out to the sqlite3 CLI or git (present only in the agent image, environment/Dockerfile:6) would fail, but the brief directs SQLite through the installed better-sqlite3 and this is not a reasonable reading of the contract; node:sqlite is built into Node 22.23. Base images use floating tags (node:22-bookworm-slim, python:3.12-slim) rather than digests in both images; template-controlled and accepted by check-dockerfiles (tag pins), so not a row defect. RISK (true): no full configured rewardkit + claude-code + OpenRouter judge run has been executed in this image for this task (raw-evidence-index scope says configured grading is absent), so 'can grade' end to end, including the judge CLI authenticating and driving playwright-mcp, is unmeasured; this review did not spend on providers. qc/REVIEW_POLICY.md ('Runtime and model evidence') requires a hash-bound full verifier launch/grading record before clearance; missing credentials/infrastructure remain an evidence gap. Launch-side is measured and passes.
